_comment: Minimal scenarios for fpsgarden. Pins core verbs: orb-collection contact rule, player movement via velocity_set_relative.

scenarios.name: player_collects_orb
scenarios._: Place player near an orb. Contact rule (radius 1.2) fires: score++, remove orb.

scenarios.name: forward_input_sets_velocity
scenarios._: Press move_north (W) → velocity_set_relative forward=4 → player gains forward velocity. At facing=0, forward = -Z (Godot convention).
